headings.style_instructions: Use for all H1-H4. Heavy weights (Bold/Black) for emphasis. Tight tracking (`tracking-tighter`). Do not center-align.

body.style_instructions: Use for paragraphs, chat messages, and descriptive text. Left-aligned, readable.

data_and_code.style_instructions: Crucial for this app. Use for all financial metrics (Spend, CPC, CTR), ad copy character counts, and labels.

surface_strategies.containers: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeletons, zero border radius (`rounded-none`). Solid backgrounds. Use 1px or 2px solid black borders for cards and sections.
surface_strategies.shadows: Hard drop shadows (`shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]`) for interactive elements like buttons and modals. No soft blurry shadows.
surface_strategies.hover_states: Invert colors on hover, or translate up and left with increased hard shadow.

layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). Dense data presentation. Use strict bento-style grids for campaign metrics.
layouts.chat_interface: Instead of a generic floating widget, use a rigid, dedicated right-hand column (`w-[350px]` or `w-[400px] border-l-2 border-black h-screen`). The chat should feel like an integrated terminal.
layouts.spacing: Generous inner padding (`p-6` or `p-8`) for containers to prevent text collision with hard borders.

components.buttons: Sharp corners, heavy text. Use `rounded-none`, high contrast colors.
components.inputs: 2px solid border, 0px border radius, stark focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black`).
components.charts: Recharts. Strip out default tooltips and grids. Use monospaced fonts for axes. Use primary accent (#002FA7) for main data lines.
components.toasts: Sonner (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js). Customize to have solid black borders and monospace font.

login_background.description: Minimalist geometric building in black and white. Use for the login/register split screen.

user_avatar.description: Professional marketer portrait for the top nav user avatar.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA. Black text on white/grey backgrounds, white text on black/blue backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Prominent focus rings required for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a strict Light theme to fit the Swiss Brutalist archetype.

Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn UI for complex interactive parts (Inputs, Selects, Dialogs). Customize Shadcn components to remove rounding (`rounded-none`) and add strong borders.
Create the AI Copilot as a fixed right-side panel, NOT a floating chat bubble, to reinforce the 'Ops tool' narrative.
In the Campaign Dashboard, use `IBM Plex Mono` for all numbers, CPC, CTR, and budgets.
Avoid generic SaaS blue and purple gradients entirely.
For the Create Campaign wizard, use a bold, step-by-step full-screen or large modal approach with clear typography.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
Do not center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep text reading flow natural.
Never use emoji characters like 🤖 or 💡 as icons. Use Lucide React icons instead.
